newsitem.title: ESTONIA: PALDISKI CHEMICAL PORT FACILITY PROPOSED-REPORT.
newsitem.headline: PALDISKI CHEMICAL PORT FACILITY PROPOSED-REPORT.

text.p: Finnish chemical storage firm Baltic Tank is considering establishing a 50 mln kroon chemical storage facility in Paldiski's northern port, Aripaev business newspaper said on Tuesday.
The proposed facility, which could handle 20,000 to 30,000 tonnes of chemicals products per year, would be a storage and not a transit facility, the newspaper added.
However, while the former closed Soviet military port town government supports the project, the town's residents are against the proposal.
Mikko Laaksonen, owner of Baltic Tank, which over 25 years of experience in such facilities in Finland said that the proposed facility will match European Union standards.
